title: Cursor MCP Server Configuration
description: Schema for mcp.json — Cursor's MCP server configuration (plugin-root mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, ~/.cursor/mcp.json). Cursor does not publish a standalone machine-readable schema for mcp.json (the official plugin.schema.json in cursor/plugins types the inline `mcpServers` field as a bare object), so this schema is derived from the official field reference at https://cursor.com/docs/context/mcp (STDIO server configuration, remote servers, static OAuth) as of 2026-07-02. Field values may contain Cursor config interpolation variables such as ${env:NAME} and ${workspaceFolder}.

mcpServers.description: Map of server name to MCP server definition.

type.description: Server connection type. Optional in practice; when present must be "stdio" for command-based servers.

command.description: Command to start the server executable. Must be on the system path or a full path.

env.description: Environment variables for the server process.

envFile.description: Path to an environment file to load additional variables (stdio servers only).

remoteServer.description: Remote MCP server reached over SSE or streamable HTTP.

type.description: Server connection type. Optional; inferred from the endpoint when omitted.

url.description: URL of the SSE or HTTP endpoint.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent to the server (e.g. Authorization).

auth.description: Static OAuth client credentials for providers without dynamic client registration.

CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from the MCP provider.

CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret, for confidential clients.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes to request. Discovered from the provider when omitted.
